name: Hotel Krupa Shitlai
description: Home-style seaside dining right by the Kelva beach sand, celebrated for wholesome authentic thalis featuring fresh Paplet, Surmai fry, prawns rassa, and Solkadhi.
address: Kelva Beach Road, Near Sitabuldi Fort Entrance, Kelva

name: Heewa Khanawal
description: Traditional family-run khanawal serving hot, wood-fired coastal meals with fish thalis, chicken vade, bombil fry, and sweet modak for beachgoers.
address: Beach Access Lane, Opp. Kelva Pine Woods, Kelva

name: Naru Vadapav & Bhujing Center
description: Legendary Palghar specialty joint famous for authentic chicken bhujing (marinated chicken roasted in coal ashes with flattened beaten rice) and hot vada pav.
address: Kelva Station Road, Kelva Town Market, Kelva

name: Aryan Farms Restaurant
description: Tranquil resort restaurant set amid betel nut and coconut groves near Kelva beach, offering both lavish seafood feasts and vegetarian Gujarati-Maharashtrian spreads.
address: Bhavani Shankar Road, Behind Kelva Beach, Kelva
